abstract: Introduction: Anti-N-methyl-D-aspartate receptor (anti-NMDAR) encephalitis is an autoimmune disease associated with the NMDA receptor. This paper describes a patient who presented with bilateral hearing loss as the initial symptom of anti-NMDAR encephalitis. Case Report: We describe a 31-year-old young female with anti-NMDAR encephalitis who presented with bilateral severe hearing loss after brief loss of consciousness and then accompanied by other symptoms, such as generalized tonic-clonic seizures, manic episodes, excessive salivation, severe cognitive impairment, and complex non-convulsive status epilepticus. Great improvement was achieved by a combined treatment of steroid, IVIG, and plasmapheresis, especially after surgical removal of the ovarian teratoma. When she was discharged on hospital day 43, her hearing loss obtained a significant improvement. Conclusion: This case study and literature review investigated the impairment of hearing loss and its subsequent treatment in patients with anti-NMDAR encephalitis.
abstract_ja: はじめに：抗N-メチル-D-アスパラギン酸受容体(抗NMDAR)脳炎は、NMDA受容体に関連する自己免疫疾患である。本稿では、両側性難聴を初発症状として呈した患者について述べる。症例報告：短時間の意識消失の後に両側性の高度難聴を呈し、その後、全般性強直間代発作、躁状態、過剰流涎、高度の認知機能障害、複雑非痙攣性てんかん重積状態などの症状を伴った31歳女性の抗NMDAR脳炎症例を述べる。ステロイド、IVIG、血漿交換の併用療法により大きな改善が得られ、特に卵巣奇形腫の外科的摘出後に改善が顕著であった。第43病日の退院時には、難聴は著明に改善していた。結論：本症例研究と文献レビューでは、抗NMDAR脳炎患者における難聴の障害とその後の治療について検討した。
